source.title: On character table of Clifford groups
source.description: Numerical mathematical table entries extracted from six HTML panels, in published character and conjugacy-class order. No article prose is redistributed.
source.cross_check: All 4489 numerical entries independently extracted from original TeX agree with the HTML transcription.

identifications.projective_group: C_3 in the paper; quotient of the finite Gaussian-dyadic Clifford group by scalar fourth roots
identifications.adjoint: Section 5.2: conjugation representation M_8 has character chi_1 + chi_10
identifications.normal_Pauli_subgroup: Section 5.2 and Theorem 5.5: unique proper nontrivial normal subgroup has order64; the identity and class2 of size63
identifications.character_table: Section6.3, characters1..67 and classes1..67 in published order

scope: The published character-table identification is cited, not independently reconstructed. Orthogonality and integrality checks detect corruption but do not establish that an abstract array is the character table of a named group. Only numerical mathematical facts are included, not article text.
